checkedAlternates.risk: Volvo is now owned by a Chinese company and is sold worldwide, so its origin may be forgotten.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The puzzle follows the founding country; Volvo was founded in Gothenburg, Sweden, in 1927.

checkedAlternates.risk: Lamborghini is owned by the German Audi group.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ownership does not change origin: the brand was founded in Italy in 1963.

checkedAlternates.risk: Audi sells many compact cars, a segment Japanese brands also fill.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Audi is a German brand founded in Zwickau in 1909.

authorReview.notes: Fact base is founding country, not current parent company.

blindPlaytest.notes: If testers split on Volvo, replace it with Saab and relabel nothing; if on Lamborghini, replace it with Alfa Romeo.
